# @three-ws/avatar-mcp

> MCP server for three.ws 3D avatars by three.ws — render a live, rotatable on-chain avatar inline (interactive MCP App), get a paste-anywhere embed iframe, or fetch avatar metadata. Free, no API key.

@three-ws/avatar-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/avatar-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-avatar-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/threews-avatar-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/threews-avatar-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/threews-avatar-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
